caption: The drawing features three views of a wooden chair-table on a cream-colored background. The upper left view shows the chair-table from above, highlighting a rectangular seat supported by a wooden frame and two wide parallel stretchers. The lower left is a front elevation, showing a high rectangular backrest that extends above the seat, which has four turned legs and straight arm supports. The rightmost view is a side elevation, displaying the chair-table’s high back tilted backward, the seat, and the detailed turned legs, armrest, and supports. The chair-table is rendered in muted shades of brown, with darker brown lines used for details and outlines. There is handwritten text in black ink in the upper right, including the title “Scale Drawing of Chair-Table” and describing its dimensions, provenance, materials (pine and oak), historical association, and gift information. The drawing is annotated with a vertical scale on the right, labeled in “Scale 1/10 = 1'.” The arms, legs, and joints show detailed woodworking typical of the period style.
title: Chair-table
